{{Quote|We use the power crystal to open a temporary hole in the shields.|Marr Idi-Shael|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
A '''power crystal''' was a rare [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] weapon found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
> by [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crosscurrent]]'' to [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].</ref> Power crystals were used to bore a hole in [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. They fire a red beam of energy that split into a spiral of red lines upon impact with the shields; the red lines then began to corkscrew, opening up a hole in the shield. Power crystals required a large amount of energy to operate. The [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] kept one on their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
